note: measurement only; no spike is re-executed and none is repaired here

controls.name: agreement_with_real_certify
controls.must_fire_because: a recomputed verdict never compared against the thing it recomputes is an assertion, not a measurement (A15)
controls.can_fail_because: certify() and stalecheck.verdict() return different states for the same synthetic pair
controls.null_must_contain: the CLEAN arm -- a rule that always answered STALE would satisfy the stale arm on its own
controls.detail: stalecheck --selfcheck, 6 arms incl. two real certify() runs

controls.name: mutation_kills_selfcheck
controls.must_fire_because: v1 shipped with the mtime second opinion -- half the rule -- unreached by any arm; deleting it left every check green
controls.can_fail_because: the synthetic cases never reach the second clock, so removing it changes no verdict
controls.null_must_contain: a green mutant, which is exactly what v1 produced and is how this control was earned

controls.name: undecidable_is_not_clean
controls.must_fire_because: scoring an unreconstructable record as clean is how a narrowed scope reads as coverage
controls.can_fail_because: no provenance.json on disk lacks source_mtimes or artifact paths
controls.null_must_contain: a run in which no record is missing inputs, which would make this control vacuous
controls.detail: records that cannot be reconstructed at all

falsifiers.name: f1_class_is_theoretical
falsifiers.can_fail_because: every provenance.json on disk is fresher than its declared deps, i.e. the STALE count is 0
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a tree in which every certified spike is fresh, which is the state the row denies
falsifiers.detail: STALE count; firing kills the row
falsifiers.refutes: if zero spikes would refuse today the class is theoretical and H187 closes WRONG
falsifiers.fires_when: every provenance.json on disk is fresher than its declared deps, i.e. the STALE count is 0
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: f2_instrument_disagrees
falsifiers.can_fail_because: certify() and stalecheck.verdict() return different states for the same synthetic input
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a disagreement, which C1 is built to surface in both directions
falsifiers.detail: inverse of C1; firing voids the row
falsifiers.refutes: if this recomputation disagrees with a real certify run, no count it produces means anything
falsifiers.fires_when: certify() and stalecheck.verdict() return different states for the same synthetic input
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: f3_undecidable_exists
falsifiers.can_fail_because: at least one provenance.json lacks source_mtimes or artifact paths and cannot be checked at all
falsifiers.null_must_contain: zero undecidable records, i.e. every spike declaring deps and artifact paths
falsifiers.refutes: records that cannot be reconstructed are counted and NAMED rather than silently scored clean
falsifiers.fires_when: at least one provenance.json lacks source_mtimes or artifact paths and cannot be checked at all

falsifier: zero spikes would refuse if certify ran today (F1)
